terminals.name: guide-app
terminals.description: Embabel Guide Spring Boot app (chat + MCP server on :1337). Waits for Neo4j, then runs ./mvnw spring-boot:run.
terminals.command: cd /agent/repos/guide && export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")")")}"; echo 'Waiting for Neo4j to be healthy...'; until sudo docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' embabel-neo4j 2>/dev/null | grep -q healthy; do sleep 3; done; ./mvnw spring-boot:run
